_readme: Known symbols for ES1's ESCD.EXE (ES1ESCD): confirmed address -> meaning mappings, applied to the ES1Recon Ghidra project by ES2ApplySymbolNames.java.
Addresses are offsets into the flat X-32 image (Herculan/docs/es1/formats/x32-executable.md#the-image).
Schema, confidence rules and run order: tools/ghidra_scripts/README.md, 'Known symbols'.
Entries are in address order. tools/scripts/es2_naming.py insert and edit keep it, and check that it holds.

entries.name: Launcher_PrefixPath
entries.description: (prefix, path), its arguments removed by this function: copies prefix into the buffer 00006584 and appends path with strcat (000032cc), less path's first two characters when its second is ':', and returns the buffer, which the next call overwrites.

entries.name: Launcher_DrivePath
entries.description: (drive, path), its arguments removed by this function: writes the drive's letter (drive + 0x40, 1 for A) and ':' into the buffer 000065a4, copies path after them less path's first two characters when its second is ':', and returns the buffer, which the next call overwrites. es2_xref finds four calls, from Launcher_Main (000005cc).

entries.name: Launcher_HasDiskSpace
entries.description: (bytes, prefix), its arguments removed by this function: the drive is the current one (dos_getdrive (00001f9c)) when prefix is empty, and otherwise prefix's first character, upper-cased, less 0x40, after an assert at severity 4 (src\es.cpp line 0x4f) through Assert_Report (000030a0) when the character-class table at 0000602d gives the character neither of bits 1 and 2. Returns 1 when dos_getdiskfreespace (00003258) gives at least bytes for the drive, compared unsigned, and 0 otherwise.

entries.name: Launcher_ReadExitCfg
entries.description: (): opens data\exit.cfg 'r+b' with fopen (000020d8) through Launcher_PrefixPath (00000304) with Launcher_PreferredPrefix (0000657c), asserting at severity 4 (src\es.cpp line 0x67) through Assert_Report (000030a0) when the open answers null, reads one 4-byte item into Launcher_State (00005854) with fread (00002edc) and closes the file with fclose (00002034).

entries.name: Launcher_FileReadable
entries.description: (path), its argument removed by this function: 0 for a null path. Otherwise it zeroes the critical-error count CritErr_Count (00005a46) and the words 00005a48 and 00005a4a, installs CritErr_Handler (00000c07) with CritErr_InstallHandler (00000bac), opens path 'rb' with fopen (000020d8), puts the old handler back with CritErr_RemoveHandler (00000bec), closes the file when it opened, and returns 1 when it opened and the count is still 0, and 0 otherwise.

entries.name: Launcher_BuildArgs
entries.description: (argv, argc), its arguments removed by this function: fills Launcher_ChildArgs (000065c4) with argc entries of argv, argv[0] included, then by Launcher_State (00005854) through the case table 00005884: for 1, 3, 4 and 6, '-a' and '-c' when Launcher_FlicPlayerFound (00005858) is set; for 5, '-D' and then '-c' when it is set; for 2, '-c' when it is set; for any other state nothing. Then '-eggplant' and a null. Returns the vector.

entries.name: Launcher_Main
entries.description: (argc, argv), C convention: es.cpp's main, which es2_xref finds called once, from the startup at 0000000d. Mem_New (00001664)(argc * 4 + 8), its answer not kept; the memory check, X32_LargestFreeBlock (00002e63)() - 25000 below 3,435,000 printing 'Insufficient memory.' and the shortfall and ending with exit (00001b50)(0); the drive prefixes Launcher_PreferredPrefix (0000657c) and Launcher_OtherPrefix (00006580) from ALT_DRIVE and PREFER_ALT, upper-cased with strupr (00002294), the first given to Assert_SetLogDir (00001814); Launcher_HasDiskSpace (000003bc)(40000, Launcher_PreferredPrefix) or exit(0); the memory figure written to data\es.got; Mem_InitHeap (000015dc)(20000); Launcher_SaveVideoMode (00000b60); with ALT_DRIVE set, the intro and end flics' command lines on the other prefix's drive; Launcher_FlicPlayerFound (00005858) from Launcher_FileReadable (000004ac). Then the loop on Launcher_State (00005854) through the case table 00005a20: 1 runs detect.exe when data\prefs.cfg does not open and the intro flic, then continues as 3 and 6, which run go.exe with spawnv (00001bf7); 4 the end flic, then go.exe; 2 and 5 dbsim.exe; each with Launcher_BuildArgs (00000518)'s vector and followed by Launcher_ReadExitCfg (00000448). spawnv's answers are not kept. At 0 it calls Launcher_RestoreVideoMode (00000b83) and Mem_HeapOff (00001658) and returns without setting EAX.

entries.name: Launcher_SaveVideoMode
entries.description: (): reads the BIOS equipment byte at linear 0x410 (0040:0010), through the selector at 000057a6, into Launcher_SavedEquipmentByte (00005a39), and the video mode INT 10h AH=0Fh answers in AL into Launcher_SavedVideoMode (00005a38).

entries.name: Launcher_RestoreVideoMode
entries.description: (): sets video mode 3 (INT 10h AX=3), writes the byte Launcher_SavedEquipmentByte (00005a39) back to linear 0x410 through the selector at 000057a6, and calls INT 10h with EAX the byte Launcher_SavedVideoMode (00005a38) sign-extended, which sets that mode when it is below 0x80.

entries.name: CritErr_InstallHandler
entries.description: (): stores DS in 00005a50 for the handler, saves INT 24h's protected-mode vector (INT 21h AX=2502h, CL=24h; EBX in 00005a3c, ES in 00005a40) and its real-mode vector (AX=2503h; EBX in 00005a42), and points INT 24h at CritErr_Handler (00000c07) in the code segment with AX=2506h.

entries.name: CritErr_RemoveHandler
entries.description: (): INT 21h AX=2507h with CL=24h, DS:EDX the protected-mode vector saved at 00005a3c and EBX the real-mode one saved at 00005a42: puts back the two vectors of INT 24h that CritErr_InstallHandler (00000bac) saved.

entries.name: CritErr_Handler
entries.description: The INT 24h handler CritErr_InstallHandler (00000bac) installs: loads DS from 00005a50, adds 1 to the count CritErr_Count (00005a46), keeps AX in 00005a4a and DI in 00005a48, and returns with STI and IRETD, AL 1 (retry) while the count is below the word CritErr_RetryLimit (00005a4c) (2 in the image) and 3 (fail) from then on.

entries.name: Mem_InitHeap
entries.description: (size): ES1GO's Mem_InitHeap (0000195f) at severity 4: caps size at X32_LargestFreeBlock (00002e63)() - 15000, takes the block from 000001ca, asserting 'Memory alloc failed' (src\memory.cpp line 0x1ee, severity 4) through Assert_Report (000030a0) when that returns -1, makes it the heap 00006614 (00000c84) and sets Mem_UseHeap (00005c18). Returns the capped size.

entries.name: Mem_HeapOff
entries.description: (): ES1GO's Mem_HeapOff (000019e1): clears Mem_UseHeap (00005c18).

entries.name: Mem_New
entries.description: (size), its argument removed by this function: ES1GO's Mem_New (000019f0) with its test the other way round: with Mem_UseHeap (00005c18) set, 00000db4(the heap 00006614, size); otherwise 000001ca(size), its -1 answered as 0.

entries.name: Assert_SetLogDir
entries.description: (dir), its argument removed by this function: ES1GO's Assert_SetLogDir (0000035e), copying dir into 00006624.

entries.name: exit
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime exit: an exact match of ES1GO's exit (0004df64) by es2_naming.py match.

entries.name: spawnl
entries.description: (mode, path, arg0, ...), C convention: spawnv (00001bf7)(mode, path, the address of arg0). es1_libmatch.py matches its bytes to spawnl, spawnlp, fprintf and sprintf alike; its callee settles it. Launcher_Main (000005cc) runs detect.exe and the flics with it.

entries.name: spawnv
entries.description: (mode, path, argv), C convention: 00001c38(0, argv, path, mode), the spawn core that 00001e4e, the core 00001c23 calls, also calls once more for each folder of the PATH variable. es1_libmatch.py matches its bytes to spawnv at 00001bf7 and 00001c23 alike.

entries.name: dos_getdrive
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `dos_getdrive`, from `dosfil.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. (pdrive), C convention: INT 21h AH=19h, and the drive it answers plus 1 (1 for A) stored through pdrive.

entries.name: dos_setdrive
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `dos_setdrive`, from `dosfil.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. (drive, pcount), C convention: INT 21h AH=0Eh with DL = drive - 1, and the drive count DOS answers in AL stored through pcount.

entries.name: fclose
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime fclose: an exact match of ES1GO's fclose (000530f8) by es2_naming.py match.

entries.name: fopen
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime fopen: an exact match of ES1GO's fopen (0005319c) by es2_naming.py match.

entries.name: fwrite
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime fwrite: an exact match of ES1GO's fwrite (000531e0) by es2_naming.py match.

entries.name: puts
entries.description: (s), C convention: writes each character of s with 0000374c to the stream at 00006164, then a newline (10); returns 1 when a write answers -1, and 0 otherwise.

entries.name: strupr
entries.description: (s), C convention: replaces each character of s by 0000412c's answer for it, upper case, and returns s. ES1GO's 0006028c has the same code calling tolower.

entries.name: getenv
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `getenv`, from `getenv.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. (name), C convention: walks the environment block at the pointer 00005e0c and answers the address after the '=' of the entry whose name equals name, or 0 at the block's end.

entries.name: printf
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime printf: an exact match of ES1GO's printf (0004e172) by es2_naming.py match.

entries.name: X32_LargestFreeBlock
entries.description: No arguments, C convention: ES1GO's X32_LargestFreeBlock (0004f738), the runtime's __x386_coreleft by es1_libmatch.py, with the high-water mark at 00005794, which the kernel sets to the image's memory size 0x67c0, and the list headed at 00006696: the extender's figure (INT 21h AX=350Bh) plus the rest of the 4 KB page above the mark, or the largest size (+4) on the list when that is larger, minus 4, or 0 when that would go below 0.

entries.name: fread
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime fread: an exact match of ES1GO's fread (0005330c) by es2_naming.py match.

entries.name: Assert_Report
entries.description: (logger, message, line, file, condition, severity) in stack order: an exact match of ES1GO's Assert_Report (0004f498) by es2_naming.py match.

entries.name: dos_getdiskfreespace
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `dos_getdiskfreespace`, from `getdos.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. (drive), C convention: INT 21h AH=36h with DL = drive (0 the current, 1 for A); answers AX * BX * CX, the bytes free, or -1 when DOS answers AX = FFFFh.

entries.name: strcat
entries.description: Symantec C++ runtime `strcat`, from `strings.ASM`: Symantec C++ 6.1's library code for it matches here whole, relocated operands masked, and the search over the image finds it at this address only. (dest, src), C convention: copies src with its terminator to the end of dest and returns dest.

entries.name: Launcher_State
entries.description: dword, 1 in the image: the state Launcher_Main (000005cc)'s loop runs by, read back from data\exit.cfg by Launcher_ReadExitCfg (00000448) after each program; Launcher_BuildArgs (00000518) reads it too.

entries.name: Launcher_FlicPlayerFound
entries.description: byte: 1 when Launcher_FileReadable (000004ac) opened playflic.exe through Launcher_OtherPrefix (00006580), set by Launcher_Main (000005cc) before the loop and again before each program. It gates the flics, the -a and -c switches Launcher_BuildArgs (00000518) adds, and which prefix detect.exe is run through.

entries.name: Launcher_SavedVideoMode
entries.description: byte: the video mode Launcher_SaveVideoMode (00000b60) reads and Launcher_RestoreVideoMode (00000b83) sets back.

entries.name: Launcher_SavedEquipmentByte
entries.description: byte: the BIOS equipment byte at 0040:0010 that Launcher_SaveVideoMode (00000b60) reads and Launcher_RestoreVideoMode (00000b83) writes back.

entries.name: CritErr_Count
entries.description: word: the critical errors CritErr_Handler (00000c07) has counted since Launcher_FileReadable (000004ac) zeroed it.

entries.name: CritErr_RetryLimit
entries.description: word, 2 in the image: CritErr_Handler (00000c07) answers retry while CritErr_Count (00005a46) is below it and fail from then on.

entries.name: Mem_UseHeap
entries.description: dword: set by Mem_InitHeap (000015dc) and cleared by Mem_HeapOff (00001658); Mem_New (00001664) takes memory from the heap 00006614 while it is set.

entries.name: Launcher_PreferredPrefix
entries.description: 4 bytes: ALT_DRIVE when PREFER_ALT is set and the empty string otherwise, upper-cased, written by Launcher_Main (000005cc): the prefix of data\es.got, data\prefs.cfg and data\exit.cfg and the drive of the disk check.

entries.name: Launcher_OtherPrefix
entries.description: 4 bytes: the empty string when ALT_DRIVE and PREFER_ALT are both set, ALT_DRIVE when only it is, and the empty string when it is not, upper-cased, written by Launcher_Main (000005cc): the prefix playflic.exe is looked for through.

entries.name: Launcher_ChildArgs
entries.description: The argument vector Launcher_BuildArgs (00000518) fills and spawnv (00001bf7) passes to go.exe and dbsim.exe.
